name: Blind Auction
tagline: Bid on mystery lots. Treasure or trap?
description: Everyone starts with 100 coins. A mystery lot comes up with a hint of what might be inside. Bid in secret: the highest bid wins the lot and pays for it. Then it flips: treasure, trap, heist or swap. Most coins at the end wins.
